skill.name: security-audit
skill.usageExample: 对这个代码库做一次完整的安全审计，找出可被利用的漏洞并生成带修复建议的审计报告。

description.zh: Cloudflare 开源的代码库安全审计技能：通过侦察、覆盖率引导的并行猎洞、对抗式验证和独立复核六个阶段，对代码库、API、服务、CLI 工具、库和守护进程做漏洞挖掘与安全评审，输出带源码证据、安全复现步骤、优先级和最小修复方案的审计报告。
description.en: Cloudflare's open-source security audit skill: finds vulnerabilities across codebases, APIs, services, CLI tools, libraries, and daemons via a six-phase workflow — reconnaissance, coverage-guided parallel hunting, adversarial validation, and independent review — producing reports with source evidence, safe reproduction, priority, and smallest effective fixes.
